persona_results.summary: No correctness finding met the confidence threshold. Static review of all 29 files; noted missing cleanup-rejection execution coverage.

findings.title: Exercise cleanup failure before the child closes
findings.why_it_matters: The cleanup-rejection handler settles a failed check when termination fails and the foreground process remains alive. Existing successful-cleanup tests would not detect removal of this handler, which could leave a formal gate waiting indefinitely for close.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a bounded regression forcing tree termination to fail while the foreground child remains alive. Assert prompt E_CHECK_FAILED rejection, the original timeout or output-limit reason, cleanup details and captured output; independently clean fixture processes in finally.
evidence: src/lib/local-checks.mjs:59-62 attaches a rejection handler to terminateTree specifically to reject before a surviving child's close event.
src/lib/local-checks.mjs:79-89 otherwise settles through child.once('close'); unsuccessful termination need not cause that event promptly.
test/unit/local-checks.test.mjs:82-116 exercises timeout and output overflow with successful cleanup and ESRCH assertions, but never forces cleanup rejection.
Existing E_CHECK_FAILED regressions cover spawn failure and F18's numeric exit-7 diagnostic, not process-tree cleanup failure.

persona_results.summary: No actionable correctness-impacting maintainability finding met the threshold. Process cleanup remains limited to foreground trees/groups.
No actionable standards violation against the constitution, recorded quick decisions and declared docs/reference/AGENTS.md. Generated bytes and hosted three-OS behavior were not rerun.
Static parity assessment passed for changed CLI/skill surfaces, including converge mode in both hooks and matching CLI behavior. No runtime Copilot invocation was performed.
No concrete adversarial finding met the threshold. Cross-platform process cleanup was inspected statically, not executed.
Read all four institutional solution documents; three directly relevant lessons and one conditional environmental lesson.
lessons: Keep ownership normalization distinct from raw upstream integrity.
Independent review requires a separate checkout identity, not a path alias.
Scope decisions need concrete diff reasoning; source-only quick records need cleanup removal.
Registry workarounds are environmental; unavailable pins are not permission to repin or claim success.
persona_results.no_match: No dedicated solution for finite check budgets, cleanup failure behavior, numeric diagnostic compatibility, all-OS uv wiring or the exact eight-file provenance boundary. Critical-patterns document is absent.

synthesis.reason: Retain the concrete testing coverage gap as open P2. No observed runtime defect is claimed. The correctness persona independently noted the same gap as a limitation, not a second finding or confidence-boosting vote. Fixes are outside this authorization.
synthesis.handoff_intent: Return to work with a blocking owner question for fix authorization; do not claim findings fixed or dismissed or proceed to land.
